Fuel your day with Cinnamon Maca Almond Butter: a warm, addictive nut butter fortified with balancing, energizing Peruvian Chacon Maca from Sol Raiz, anti-inflammatory cinnamon spice, and calming vanilla. Each bite is loaded with rich, healthy fats and proteins from our sprouted almonds. All of our nuts and ingredients are stone-ground in order to create their signature smooth and creamy texture. JEM Organics is USDA Certified Organic and their nut butters use only the finest, ethically sourced ingredients. We've chosen to use a single origin, heirloom varietal of Maca, so that the active alkaloids associated with Maca are actually present and working in our nut butter. Our butters are good for the planet and for the body. It’s the perfect healthy snack for anyone and for all those vegan, paleo or keto dieters out there. This fan favorite almond butter is best with pancakes, yogurt, apples and, of course, it’s best straight from the jar.
